name: alfred
description: Alfred — a personal chat assistant that manages your Claude Code projects
author: mrmoneycoach

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p mcp-server/tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-mcp-pkg.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alfred listens for the wake word "Alfred" to accept voice commands.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Alfred transcribes your voice so it can respond to spoken commands.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Alfred uses AppleScript to control Calendar, Reminders, Notes, and paste text into your apps on your behalf.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Alfred creates and reads events in your Mac Calendar when you ask it to.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Alfred creates and lists reminders in the Reminders app when you ask it to.
